page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no margin notes. Printed page number 341 at the top right, running head "LIBER." at the top left. Catchword "fixum" at the bottom right, gathering signature "Y 3" at the bottom left.

main_text.p: Quin si abfque pondere vectem manu deprimas, quo longiùs ab hypomochlio prenderis; eo majorem vim æquali tamen conatu inferes. Unde & usus vectium ad moles graves facilè submovendas. Quippe si ve-ctis extremum quod rei movendæ supponitur ab hypomochlio pedem unicum emineat, oppositaque ve-rò pars oblonga sexto à fulcro pede prematur; idem conatus inferet vim sextuplam, tantumque movebit unus quantum sex qui sine ve-cte, manibus hanc mo-lem submovere conarentur.

Æqualem hæc distantia vim præbet ad res deprimendas. Esto veluti rotæ axis, lignum teres, circa quod trabes perforata volvatur; ita ut uno pede alterum trabis extremum axem relinquat; alterum verò sex pedes. Qui supposita manu vel capite illud extremum sexto ab axe pede sustulerit, æquivalebit sex qui æquali conatu alterum extremum uno ab axe pede tollere nitentur. Unde hæc virtutis mul-tiplicatio?
main_text.head: ARTICVLVS III. Quo hujus rei causa redditur.
main_text.p: EXperientia docet baculum seu virgam quam rei cujusquam immotæ foramini impegeris, si torqueas, non modò juxta illud foramen atque in illo extremo flexum & ruptum iri; sed quantò longior ea virga fuerit, si altero extremo prensam inflectas, tanto promptius frangit. Monstratum est autem, non posse frangi quippiam, nisi par[?]ribus eo loco paulatim, gradatimque deductis, donec nimia laxatione facta fiat earum plenaria solutio. Ergo qua parte res citius, faciliusque rumpitur; certum est ibi majorem, promtioremque fieri partium diductionem. At quò longiùs prensam torques, eò facilius virga vel res alia frangitur juxta alterum extremum quod

page.notes: The word "parribus" in the fourth-last line of the last paragraph is doubtful; it is probably "partibus" and is marked [?]. The printed hyphens at line ends ("ve-ctis", "ve-rò", "ve-cte", "mo-lem", "mul-tiplicatio") are kept as printed. The paragraph opening "Quin" is treated as a continuation from the previous page. The catchword "fixum" is at the right foot and is not repeated in the text.
